title: PowerShell profile configuration
description: Declares the named profile configurations Initialize-PSProfile.ps1 can apply to a session: the modules it imports, the aliases it registers, its PSReadLine settings and its prompt. baseConfiguration is merged into the selected configuration, which wins on every key it sets itself.

defaultConfigurationId.description: Key in `configuration` applied when the caller passes no -ProfileId.

baseConfiguration.description: Settings merged into every configuration. A key the selected configuration sets itself is not overwritten; nested objects are merged key by key.

configuration.description: The profile configurations, keyed by the identifier -ProfileId selects.

configurationId.description: Identifier of a profile configuration: letters, digits, underscore and hyphen.

name.description: Display name, applied as the console window title.

modules.description: Modules imported when the profile loads. A module that fails to import is reported through $ProfileError, not thrown.

aliases.description: Aliases registered in the global scope, replacing any alias of the same name.

prompt.description: Prompt style passed to Build-Prompt. Ignored with a warning when that command is not available.

repository.description: PSResource repository the module is published to. Documentation only - the import resolves through PSModulePath.

version.description: Version to import. Documentation only - the import takes whatever version resolves first.

value.description: Command or cmdlet the alias points to.

colors.description: PSReadLine token colours, keyed by token name (Command, Parameter, String, ...).

keyHandlers.description: Named key handlers to bind. Only the names Initialize-PSProfile.ps1 implements do anything; an unknown name is ignored silently.
